title: ddPCR Protocol for Detection and Quantification of Integrated HIV Psi Sequence
author: Hayley Todesco
materials: Extract genomic DNA using the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (QIAGEN) Qiagen Catalog #69504 and >96% anhydrous ethanol. Follow the kit manufacturer’s instructions with an additional step of adding 4 µL RNase A Qiagen Catalog #19101 per sample prior to the addition of Buffer AL.

Quantify the dsDNA concentration of each DNA extract using the Qubit 1X dsDNA HS Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q33230 or Q33231 and Qubit assay tubes Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32856 according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Qubit 4 (Fluorometer, Invitrogen, Q33238)

Generate droplets using DG32™ Automated Droplet Generator Cartridges Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864108 , Pipet Tips for the AutoDG Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864120 , Pierceable Foil Heat Seals Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #17005225 , and Automated Droplet Generation Oil for Probes Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1864110 following the manufacturer’s instructions. PX1 PCR Plate Sealer (Plate Sealer, Bio-Rad, 1814000, https://www.bio-rad.com/en-at/sku/1814000-px1-pcr-plate-sealer?ID=1814000 ) Automated Droplet Generator (Droplet Digital PCR System, Bio-Rad, 1864101, https://www.bio-rad.com/en-at/sku/1864101-automated-droplet-generator?ID=1864101 ) Sorvall Legend X1R (Centrifuge, ThermoScientific)

Using 1D amplitude plots, apply manual amplitude thresholds: 1000 amplitude units for FAM (Psi target) 2000 amplitude units for HEX (RPP30 reference) QX Manager Premium Edition 2.3 Bio-Rad Laboratories

Extract genomic DNA using the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (QIAGEN) Qiagen Catalog #69504 and >96% anhydrous ethanol. Follow the kit manufacturer’s instructions with an additional step of adding 4 µL RNase A Qiagen Catalog #19101 per sample prior to the addition of Buffer AL.

steps.title: Pellet cells from PBMCs
steps.instruction: Pellet 5 × 10^5 cells from isolated PBMCs at 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 minutes using an Accuspin 21R Refrigerated Microcentrifuge (Fisherbrand, catalog #13100677) and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellet in PBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 µL of PBS, pH 7.4 (Gibco‑Thermo Fisher Scientific, catalog #10010023).

steps.title: Quantify and dilute DNA extracts
steps.instruction: Quantify the extracted genomic DNA, then prepare dilutions so that the concentration is ≤ 4.1 ng/µL (i.e., ≤ 33 ng per 8 µL) using Invitrogen™ UltraPure™ DNase/RNase‑Free Distilled Water (Thermo Fisher Scientific, catalog #10‑977‑015).

steps.title: Assemble singleplex ddPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: In a laminar‑flow PCR workstation, prepare each singleplex ddPCR reaction to a final volume of 22 µL in a Bio‑Rad ddPCR 96‑well plate (catalog #12001925) as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add ≤ 33 ng genomic DNA in 8 µL water.
Add 1× ddPCR Supermix for probes (no dUTP) (Bio‑Rad, catalog #1863024) to reach the required final volume.
Add 1 µL of BamHI‑HF (5 units; stock 50,000 units, New England Biolabs, catalog #R3136L) diluted in Invitrogen UltraPure water.
Add 1× rCutSmart Buffer (New England Biolabs, catalog #B6004).
Add 1× custom primer/probe mix: either 20× HIV Psi Custom Probe/Primer (FAM, Bio‑Rad, catalog #dEXD14812826) or 20× RPP30 Custom Probe/Primer (HEX, Bio‑Rad, catalog #dHsaMDS117591774).
Add nuclease‑free water to bring the total reaction volume to 22 µL.

steps.title: Load reactions and include controls
steps.instruction: Dispense each reaction into the ddPCR plate, running Psi (target) and RPP30 (reference) reactions in triplicate singleplex wells; also set up DNA extraction controls and no‑template controls as appropriate.

steps.title: Generate droplets per manufacturer instructions
steps.instruction: Follow the ddPCR system and AutoDG manufacturer’s instructions to generate droplets and seal the plate before thermal cycling.

steps.title: Thermal cycle ddPCR plates
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate in a PTC Tempo Deepwell Thermal Cycler (Bio‑Rad, catalog #12015392) with the heated lid set to 105 °C and a maximum ramp rate of 2 °C/s. Run the following program:

steps.title: Read fluorescence from droplets
steps.instruction: Using a QX600 Droplet Reader (Bio‑Rad, catalog #12013328) with ddPCR™ Droplet Reader Oil (catalog #1863004) and the “Direct Quantification” setting in QX Manager Premium Edition 2.3, measure fluorescence intensity from a minimum of 10 000 droplets per sample.

steps.title: Calculate Psi per cell ratio
steps.instruction: Apply the software‑generated threshold‑adjusted concentrations to the formula Psi:Cell = (Psi concentration (copies/µL)) / [0.5 × RPP30 concentration (copies/µL)] to obtain the Psi per cell value.
